name: Ultroid UserBot
description: Pluggable telegram userbot, made in python using Telethon.

SESSION.description: Telethon string session of your account. Make it with `python3 sessiongen` or @SessionGeneratorBot. (REQUIRED)

API_ID.description: From my.telegram.org (optional, a default is used if empty).

API_HASH.description: From my.telegram.org (optional, a default is used if empty).

REDIS_URI.description: Database. Free Redis from redis.io / upstash.com, e.g. redis://default:pass@host:port. Or leave empty and fill MONGO_URI.

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Only if your REDIS_URI is host:port without password.

MONGO_URI.description: Alternative database: free MongoDB Atlas URL.

HEROKU_API.description: Heroku API key (for .usage and restarts). Optional.

HEROKU_APP_NAME.description: Your Heroku app name (same as above). Optional.
